subject: Halo 2 Kills
author: Xandu
body:
I know what you mean about not killing people in Halo 2... To me it seems like lots of FPSs have some kind of lag issues. I remember a couple of times when I played Halo 2 where I didnt even have to aim at people... Just shoot in the general direction of something moving and I had a kill... other times I could play games and end up with zero kills. The same goes for Rainbow 6 Vegas, Quake 4 and lots of other games. I just wish I could find a way to constantly stay in this state as it is really fun because other players get really pissed off 😈. An alternative would be to compensate for the lag... I've seen some players that are really good at this... it takes skill! You see them shooting at a wall....and what??? they got a kill??? how the f*? 😕

-- The Creator --

subject: I concur
author: drunknnumpty
body:
amazingly I agree with most of what Boot says.. although I would suggest he play the campain on Co-op as this is quite a fun way to get through it.. with the extra fire power it makes it a lot quicker and you can have fun blowing up each other as well.. Sorry Lucan, Suf n Blo if I 'accidential' shot any of you yesterday..

 

shame about the lag that we experience in larger games although have to admit the movement and killing people is fun.. esp when I do actually kill people which I couldnt on Halo 2...

 

graphically it is amazing.. keep getting distracted by the pretty colours...

 

theres a thin line between genius and insanity... i think i've fallen off...

subject: Loving the movie editor on H3.
author: SUFFUR
body:
The clan sort of played a couple of games and it was fun but laggy, but one game on SnowBound, was great and i got some great footage and photos of that map, and the cool thing is even though i have done my version of a game/film, anyone watching can change the angle of the camera and look at it from a diffrent point of view, well any point of view truth be told, for any JAM claners who want to see my first trys, look at my file share, some fun stuff going on. I still have a long way to go to get some great footage per say, but what i want to do now is edit them together and i have sort how to do that, any hints Sonic? Pausing, pauses bullets in the air and i got a nice photo of me shooting MightyMuffin, with shells caught in midair, nice.

Boot you should give the co-op a go, i think you might like it, and though you are not an Gamerscore Whore(TM), it will give out achievements, if you do? And it's an interesting viewing experiance.

Though i do think the story is a bit short, around 10 hours of game play, that can be revisited with friends in Co-op, to expand it to many, many hours. But it looks good and plays well, and it does finish the god damn fight!

Whats out next? other than Paradise?

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when its going to run out?
